title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Apply your brand kit and style to visual creations
description: Easily customize your prompt output with built-in controls to select your preferred style and choose the format, whether it’s a poster, infographic, or image. With a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, apply your organization brand kit to create on-brand content without manually uploading assets and describing your style.
